units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:8:2">Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16ᶜ</cite> top <he>אינה היא א׳</he> that is not the proper way (= <he>לא זו הדרך</he>), i.e. it is inconsistent that the same formula should be illegal in the case of a letter of divorce, and legal in the case of a donation.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:3:5">Y. Gitt. VII, 48ᵈ</cite> <he>אינה איסרתה</he> (corr. acc., and supplement acc. to Y. B. Bath. l. c.).
